evidence: Reviewed all 157 criterion descriptions (145 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual, 2 gates), not only a keyword scan. The workbook row 34 requires ONE full-credit bar; its internal flow annotation does not override current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md independent-credit rules. No description was found to demand an outcome and then waive that same outcome. .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:101,110,119,128,137 keep each exact financial result mandatory while making P5a conditional only on actually observed claim-bearing requests; functional/prompt.md:39-41 defines that condition and public hireops_rules.md:363-368 explicitly allows omitting claims. Similarly judge.toml:677 conditions imported-DRAFT eligibility on optional imported history, matching instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:91-95. These are explicit applicability conditions, not two competing passing bars. Independent fallback setups preserve the owned result: functional/judge.toml:524 still needs second-generation lineage; :605 still requires a completed revision witness for historical-grant protection; :632 isolates schedule/cap from odd-unit rounding with an equivalent 100-unit control; :1136 preserves every earlier artifact actually recorded rather than excusing a changed artifact. Creation and preservation have separate owners. Functional/prompt.md:11 expressly denies unearned credit when the owned outcome cannot be observed. .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:41,50 require an actual refused preparation/commit, retained otherwise-valid input, and successful correction. A legally deferred budget refusal uses malformed-input setup for preparation, and a broken economic-history branch uses a separate real refusal for recovery; neither clause waives refusal or recovery. :59 still requires forwarding the actual commit before dropping response delivery and retrying the same saved operation. Gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 consistently require both newly created records and independent-context readback while excluding later settlement arithmetic. Visual/judge.toml:24-89 has one maximum-score anchor per owned property; lower anchors are gradation, not alternative full credit. Checked existing raw corroboration, not peer findings: local/partial-budget-recovery.cjs:19-22,35-59 intentionally removes economic-history freshness, observes a wrong ABA success, then asserts a separate real budget refusal, unchanged editor values and successful new-key recovery. Its results.json records all three observations passed. local/targeted-golden.cjs:30-46 asserts actual 409 preparation refusal, retained terms and correction; its results.json records the observation passed. These bounded fixtures support the intended separate outcomes, not a configured grade. Raw-index verification at review time: index SHA256 b4a66ac8b5245e42688b350109bdd13ceef26168322eb4f5e984e83ea8b41d7f; all 283 listed artifact hashes and all 5 distinct matching_source_files bindings match. partial-budget-recovery/results.json SHA256 afd494316961a21106f615048bd30a52faec1ad7977bee69c527a06229be222b and targeted-golden/results.json SHA256 016ecfc3ec82e063f4028f4466438fcc7b80d91f48b26b1787c5231bf5ce13c5 verified; both records' 14 original-source hashes match the frozen solution. Scope limit: this Pass is textual criterion self-consistency only. Full configured judge duration/completion, empirical app reward discrimination/ranking, target/Oracle and hosted scores remain absent per the raw index. These are unresolved overall clearance risks and are not waived or inferred from the scripted fixtures; no new runtime or provider run was performed for row 33.
counterexample: Broken-app challenge: a UI that loses a member destination after a genuinely refused commit cannot pass hro_pol_change_recovery under either its preferred or fallback refusal setup (polish/judge.toml:50); a dead payment writer cannot pass relocation exclusion because an actual matching nonzero signing payment is mandatory (functional/judge.toml:497,551,596). The available deliberate ABA mutant can retain Polish recovery credit while failing hro_change_aba (functional/judge.toml:1055); that is the explicitly separated outcome, not a waived freshness bar. Conforming-alternative challenge: an app omitting computed-claim request fields and operational demo imports, generating IDs, using expandable receipts and rejecting final budget excess at commit remains eligible under the explicit conditions (functional/judge.toml:101,677,947,1001; polish/judge.toml:41). No conflicting second target was found that would fail this alternative.
